ledger_purpose: Per-file verdict artifact covering every CU1 target. The no-silent-skip contract for downstream corpus plans (CU2-CU5): each must diff its scope against this ledger. Absence of a downstream target from this ledger is an error in the downstream plan, not a free pass. Recorded 2026-07-08 by slice s6 (runs LAST) against the FINAL on-disk state after s1-s5 shipped; line_count and section_count read fresh from disk.
